exposure: Type of hypertensive disorder (pre-eclampsia vs. other)
cohort: 368 women delivering at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH) in Accra, Ghana, between January 1 and February 28, 2013, whose pregnancies were complicated by hypertensive disorders
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy are associated with high rates of adverse maternal outcomes in Ghana, particularly in women with pre-eclampsia.
